sentences.text: Hello, hello? Hey, you're doing great! Most people don't last this long. I mean, not that they... they usually move on to other things. Anyway.
I don't have much to say tonight. Things start getting real on night three.
Here's an idea, though. If you get caught and want to avoid the whole suit thing, try to play dead. Go limp. Maybe they'll think you're an empty costume.
Then again, if they think you're an empty costume they might try to stuff a metal skeleton inside you. Not sure how that would go. ...Yeah, never mind, scratch that. Best not to get caught.
Alright, I'll leave you to it. Talk to you tomorrow.
